The entire path to learning AI — every stage, nothing skipped Most people learning AI are collecting tricks — a video about prompts on Monday, something about agents on Thursday, a new tool every week. Every piece is real, and none of it stacks, because it's arriving in a random order. Skills compound when each one stands on the one before it. So here's the whole path, in order — and for each stage, what you can do at the end that you couldn't at the start: 1. AI FOUNDATIONS — you hand AI real work with real context, and what comes back is work you'd actually use. 2. THE THINKER'S MIND — you draw your own work as a system: where the hours go, where technology belongs, and where it would just speed up a mess. 3. AUTOMATIONS — work moves between your tools on its own. You touched none of it. 4. AI AUTOMATIONS — a brain sits inside your flows: sorting, drafting, flagging the one that needs you. 5. VIBE CODING — you build working tools by describing them in plain English. 6. CLAUDE CODE FROM ZERO — you hand whole jobs to agents that plan, work, check themselves, and finish — then build a team of them. Add it together: you stop asking a chatbot for favors, and you start running a team that works while you sleep. And the lessons are half of what's inside — the other half is the platform members customize into their own agent team. #aiagent #learnai #aiemployee #aiautomation
